cohort: 950 Italian-speaking women who underwent vaginal or Cesarean deliveries of uncomplicated singleton pregnancies at term
finding: Women who underwent Cesarean deliveries had higher EPDS scores and higher scores on the depression, anxiety, and anhedonia subscales compared to women who underwent vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Women who underwent Cesarean deliveries had higher EPDS scores and higher scores on the depression, anxiety, and anhedonia subscales compared to women who underwent vaginal deliveries.
